design_note: GRAVE V13 - shell rebuilt on the preserved V12 core (28 internal nodes) following the user design sheet SERA HEAD D-02 GRAVE (2026-11-28). Proportions retargeted to the sheet W1.00/H0.82/D1.28: core remapped (z x0.80 about z=0.30, x x1.08, y x1.03; cylinder radii kept true so lens/bearings stay round). New shell: wide forehead brim with the mono-eye deeply recessed under it, enlarged planar cheek blocks, exposed side-unit rings over the bearings (sheet part 6), layered rear armor with cooling slits, maintenance hatch and twin rear fins, dark chin guard with jaw spike, cyan sub-sensors beside the lens. Intentional overlaps are declared for assembly fits and mount contacts per SERA_knowledge 2026-11-27-12. Bolts and panel lines are deferred to texture per SERA_knowledge 2026-11-27-19 (skeleton first, shell second). Edge roles per 2026-11-27-17: silhouette edges stay sharp, no normals tricks.
